description:
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.  

 At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device. We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.  

 A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone. 

 As a Software Engineer on the Data Tooling Team you will contribute to well-scoped improvements to shared data tools and workflows, working with technical guidance from experienced engineers. Your work will help people understand data health and ownership, find and use appropriate datasets, and improve data operations safely. You’ll learn how these tools are tested, released, monitored, and supported in production while building reliable, maintainable software.

 You Will 

 
 Implement and improve scoped components or features in shared tools for data quality, lineage, metadata, ownership, observability, lifecycle management, and optimization.

 Help turn signals such as freshness, quality results, lineage, usage, and compute or storage cost into useful alerts, dashboards, recommendations, or workflows.

 Write clear, maintainable code with appropriate tests and documentation, following established design patterns and engineering practices.

 Learn production-readiness and operational practices, including instrumentation, rollout, monitoring, and investigating issues; work with experienced engineers on incidents and escalate risks promptly.

 Contribute to AI-assisted data workflows by extending established permissions, traceability, safety checks, evaluation, and human-approval patterns. Help test these workflows and report unexpected or unsafe behavior.

 Collaborate with teammates and partner teams to clarify requirements, coordinate changes, and deliver reusable improvements. Ask questions and raise ambiguity, dependencies, or risks when they affect the work.

 
 You Have 

 
 1-3 years of experience in software engineering, with a track record of delivering high-quality production code.

 Software engineering fundamentals and experience writing code in at least one general-purpose programming language.

 Familiarity with working with data, such as SQL, data pipelines, or structured datasets, or an interest in developing those skills.

 A careful approach to implementation, testing, debugging, and documenting your work.

 Willingness to learn unfamiliar systems and production practices with guidance, seek feedback, and incorporate it.

 Clear communication and a collaborative approach to working with engineers and data partners.

 Sound judgment about when requirements are unclear, a change may affect other users, or an automated action needs review; and readiness to ask for help or escalate.

 
 Please note the Company may not be able to employ candidates who have United States work authorization related to certain U.S. visa categories, or support future F-1 or H-1B sponsorship at this time.
 For roles that are based at our headquarters in San Mateo, CA: The starting base pay for this position is as shown below. The actual base pay is dependent upon a variety of job-related factors such as professional background, training, work experience, location, business needs and market demand. Therefore, in some circumstances, the actual salary could fall outside of this expected range. This pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. All full-time employees are also eligible for equity compensation and for benefits as described on this page .

 Annual Salary Range
 $153,120 — $196,750 USD 


 Roles that are based in an office are onsite Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday, with optional presence on Monday and Friday (unless otherwise noted).

 Roblox provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. Roblox also provides reasonable accommodations to candidates with qualifying disabilities or religious beliefs during the recruiting process.

 For US based roles only, please note the Company may not be able to employ candidates for this role who have United States work authorization related to certain U.S. visa categories, or support future H-1B sponsorship at this time.
